You have tools: websearch, webfetch, bash, grep, read. The internet may or may not be reachable. Your job: find two numbers.

A) Omar Valencia-Mendez (O. M. Valencia-Mendez) 2017 paper/report on the harlequin shrimp (Hymenocera picta or Hymenocera elegans) — the TOTAL LENGTH of the shrimp recorded (with units).
B) G. Curt Fiedler 2002 paper on harlequin shrimp fed a sea star (likely "Novel prey of the harlequin shrimp Hymenocera picta", Journal of Crustacean Biology) — the SIZE of the sea star fed to the shrimp (with units).

Try in this order:
1. bash with curl/wget, e.g.: `curl -s "https://api.crossref.org/works?query.bibliographic=Valencia-Mendez+harlequin+shrimp"` and `curl -s "https://api.duckduckgo.com/?q=harlequin+shrimp+Valencia-Mendez+2017&format=json"` and `curl -sL "https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q=..."`. Also try python3 with urllib/requests.
2. websearch / webfetch tools.
If EVERY network route fails with "permission required but no prompt available", report that plainly and list exactly which commands/tools you tried. Do not fabricate numbers.
